body: Heats evenly and the two handles make it easy to move a full skillet off the burner. Eggs slide once it is properly preheated.
Perfect size for a whole fish. The surface seasoned up quickly and cleanup was just a wipe and a light oil.
Great for sauces and reheating leftovers. It comes up to heat fast on our induction cooktop and the pour is clean.
We use this every weekend for pancakes and smash burgers. It covers both burners and stays hot the whole time.
Fits tight and keeps the pan from drying out. Easy to lift with one hand and it looks right sitting on the skillet.
